note: Stage 1 text must show potential problems only - never solutions, methods, products or costs. Placeholders: {elevation} {distance} {travel}. Set approved to true only when Stuart has signed the rule off.

rules.trigger: Per elevation: distance to boundary under 25 m AND cladding fire rating is 'unknown' or 'not rated'. Rated cladding = no flag.
rules.stage1Problem: Elevation {elevation} is {distance} m from the boundary – this wall may need to meet fire separation rules.
rules.stage1WhyItMatters: Walls close to a boundary are limited in how much fire can spread to the neighbouring site.

rules.trigger: Per elevation: distance to boundary under 1 m.
rules.stage1Problem: Elevation {elevation} is under 1 m from the boundary – strict fire rules apply to this wall.
rules.stage1WhyItMatters: Very close walls face the tightest fire limits, which can affect the wall and any openings in it.

rules.trigger: Mean roof height ((eaves + ridge) / 2) over 10 m.
rules.stage1Problem: Your building height may need a specialist fire assessment.
rules.stage1WhyItMatters: Taller buildings are treated differently for fire spread and may need a specialist assessment.

rules.regsRef: Building Regulations fire safety - buildings with a ridge height over 18 m
rules.trigger: Ridge height (measured at the ridge, not mean roof height) over 18 m.
rules.stage1Problem: Your ridge height is over 18 m - stricter rules apply.
rules.stage1WhyItMatters: Taller buildings face tighter fire safety requirements.

rules.trigger: B_BOUNDARY flagged AND eaves height over 7 m.
rules.stage1Problem: The frame and foundations near the boundary may need extra design checks.
rules.stage1WhyItMatters: A tall wall close to a boundary can affect how the frame and foundations are designed.

rules.trigger: Furthest point in plan to nearest personnel or fire-exit door, straight line x 1.5. Limits: normal hazard 45 m (exits in 2+ directions) / 25 m (one direction); flammable storage 25 m / 12 m. Roller doors and doors into another building do not count.
rules.stage1Problem: The furthest point is about {travel} m from an exit – this may be over the limit.
rules.stage1WhyItMatters: People inside need to reach an exit within a set distance if there is a fire.

rules.trigger: People = floor area / 30 m2 (storage) or / 5 m2 (production). Over 60 people AND fewer than 2 exits.
rules.stage1Problem: Your building may need more fire exits.
rules.stage1WhyItMatters: A building this size can hold more people than a single exit is allowed to serve.

rules.trigger: ONLY if heated for people working inside (fully heated; not unheated, frost protection, localised heaters or heated office only). No fixed U-value rule.
rules.stage1Problem: Heated buildings need an energy calculation (SBEM/BRUKL) for Building Control.
rules.stage1WhyItMatters: Building Control will ask for this calculation with the application.

rules.trigger: Building Control application on/after 24 Mar 2027, OR start on/after 24 Mar 2028.
rules.stage1Problem: New 2027 energy rules may apply to your project.
rules.stage1WhyItMatters: Projects submitted or started after these dates are assessed against the newer rules.
